note: Seed research-area taxonomy for the Big-Four security KB. Each paper is classified into 1-3 of these. 'keywords' aid both LLM classification and client-side search.

topics.name: Web & Browser Security
topics.description: Attacks and defenses for the web platform: browsers, JavaScript, the DOM, web apps, and server-side web code.

topics.name: Network Security
topics.description: Security of network protocols and infrastructure: routing, DNS, BGP, middleboxes, DDoS, and traffic analysis.

topics.name: Applied Cryptography
topics.description: Practical cryptographic constructions, attacks on deployed crypto, and crypto engineering.

topics.name: Cryptographic Protocols
topics.description: Design and analysis of cryptographic protocols such as TLS, key exchange, messaging, and PKI.

topics.name: Adversarial Machine Learning
topics.description: Adversarial examples, poisoning, backdoors, evasion, and robustness of ML models.

topics.name: ML Privacy & Model Security
topics.description: Privacy attacks against ML (membership inference, model/data extraction, inversion) and federated-learning security.

topics.name: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies
topics.description: Systems and measurements for user privacy: tracking, anonymization, private data sharing, and privacy on the web/mobile.

topics.name: Differential Privacy
topics.description: Differentially private mechanisms, analytics, and deployments, including local DP.

topics.name: Anonymity & Censorship Resistance
topics.description: Anonymous communication (Tor, mix nets) and tools to detect or circumvent censorship.

topics.name: Operating Systems & Systems Security
topics.description: Kernel and OS-level security, isolation, sandboxing, virtualization, and access control.

topics.name: Memory Safety & Exploitation
topics.description: Memory-corruption bugs, exploitation techniques, and mitigations (ASLR, CFI, sanitizers).

topics.name: Fuzzing & Automated Testing
topics.description: Fuzzing techniques, coverage-guided testing, and bug-finding pipelines.

topics.name: Program Analysis
topics.description: Static/dynamic analysis, symbolic execution, taint tracking, and bug detection for security.

topics.name: Binary Analysis & Reverse Engineering
topics.description: Disassembly, decompilation, binary similarity, and reverse engineering of compiled code.

topics.name: Hardware Security
topics.description: Security of hardware: chips, FPGAs, PUFs, fault injection, and hardware design verification.

topics.name: Side-Channel & Microarchitectural Attacks
topics.description: Timing, cache, power, EM, and speculative-execution (Spectre/Meltdown) side channels and defenses.

topics.name: Trusted Execution Environments
topics.description: TEEs and enclaves (Intel SGX, ARM TrustZone, TDX, SEV), attestation, and confidential computing.

topics.name: Mobile Security
topics.description: Security and privacy of Android and iOS apps, permissions, app stores, and mobile platforms.

topics.name: IoT & Embedded Security
topics.description: Security of IoT devices, embedded systems, firmware, and smart-home ecosystems.

topics.name: Cyber-Physical & Autonomous Vehicle Security
topics.description: Security of cyber-physical systems, ICS/SCADA, robotics, drones, and autonomous/connected vehicles.

topics.name: Wireless & Cellular Security
topics.description: Security of cellular (4G/5G), Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS, and other RF/wireless protocols.

topics.name: Authentication & Passwords
topics.description: Password security, biometrics, multi-factor and passwordless authentication (FIDO/WebAuthn).

topics.name: Usable Security & Privacy
topics.description: Human factors: user studies, mental models, warnings, and the usability of security and privacy tools.

topics.name: Malware Analysis & Defense
topics.description: Detection, classification, and analysis of malware, botnets, and ransomware.

topics.name: Cybercrime & Internet Measurement
topics.description: Empirical measurement of cybercrime, underground economies, abuse, fraud, and large-scale internet ecosystems.

topics.name: Phishing & Social Engineering
topics.description: Phishing, social engineering, disinformation, and human-targeted deception.

topics.name: Blockchain & Smart Contract Security
topics.description: Security of blockchains, consensus, cryptocurrencies, DeFi, and smart contracts.

topics.name: Secure Computation (MPC, FHE, ZK)
topics.description: Secure multiparty computation, homomorphic encryption, zero-knowledge proofs, and private set operations.

topics.name: Vulnerability Discovery & Disclosure
topics.description: Finding vulnerabilities at scale, CVE/patch analysis, bug bounties, and disclosure processes.

topics.name: Software Supply-Chain Security
topics.description: Security of dependencies, package registries, build systems, CI/CD, and code provenance.

topics.name: LLM & Generative-AI Security
topics.description: Security and privacy of large language models and generative AI: prompt injection, jailbreaks, and LLM-assisted security.

topics.name: Digital Forensics
topics.description: Forensic analysis, attack reconstruction, provenance, and incident response.

topics.name: Formal Methods for Security
topics.description: Formal verification, proofs, and verified implementations of security-critical systems and protocols.
